data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Melissa, meaning 'honeybee' or 'majestic'. In Greek mythology, Melissa was a nymph who tended to Apollo and became a bee after her death. In Christianity, Melissa can represent graciousness, devotion, and sweetness. The name Mellisa carries the meaning “Majestic, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mellisa usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mellisa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Melissa carries a beautiful meaning deeply rooted in ancient Greek mythology and culture. It evokes images of industrious honeybees, symbolizing hard work, productivity, and community in various industries and aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Melissa can serve as a reminder to be like the industrious honeybee – working hard in our daily lives, staying devoted to our inner callings, and spreading sweetness and inspiration to those around us. In a Christian context, Melissa can also evoke the idea of being a devoted child of God, constantly tending to and seeking nourishment from the Divine.
